definitions.explanation: A bad person; the villain in a story, or the one treated as being at fault in a situation.

examples.japanese: {悪者|わるもの}をやっつける。
{物語|ものがたり}には{必|かなら}ず{悪者|わるもの}が{出|で}てくる。
examples.english: A story always has a villain in it.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}だけが{悪者|わるもの}にされて{納得|なっとく}がいかない。
examples.english: I can't accept being made out to be the only bad guy.

notes:
Refers to a villain in fiction or, more loosely, the person blamed in a real situation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪者|わるもの}にする: to make someone the bad guy; to scapegoat
- {悪者|わるもの}{扱|あつか}い: treating someone as the villain
- {悪者|わるもの}を{退治|たいじ}する: to vanquish the villain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {悪人|あくにん}: a bad or evil person — more serious, morally weighty
- {悪役|あくやく}: a villain role (in drama) — the acted part rather than a real bad person
